description_en: Use the `BatchAddCdnDomain` operation to add up to 50 accelerated domain names in a single request
description_zh: 调用BatchAddCdnDomain可以实现批量添加加速域名，一次最多可以添加50个加速域名
kebab_example: aliyun cdn batch-add-cdn-domain --cdn-type web --domain-name example.com,aliyundoc.com --sources content_:_192.0.2.0_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:_80,_weight_:_15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchAddCdnDomain

parameters.help_en:
The service type of the accelerated domain. Valid values:

web: small files and images.

download: large file downloads.

video: VOD acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名的业务类型。取值：

web：图片小文件。

download：大文件下载。

video：视音频点播
parameters.name: cdn_type

parameters.help_en: The domain names to add to CDN. Separate multiple domains with a comma
parameters.help_zh: 需要接入CDN的加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. If you omit this parameter, the system automatically uses the ID of the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，不传时，自动补全默认资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The service area. Valid values:

domestic: Chinese mainland only.

overseas: Global (excluding Chinese mainland).

global: Global
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域。取值：

domestic：仅中国内地。

overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。

global：全球
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The root domain name, such as example.com
parameters.name: top_level_domain
